name: open settings, HUD tab
eval: (()=>{document.getElementById('settings-open').click(); const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('#settings [role=tab]')].find(t=>/hud/i.test(t.textContent)); t.click(); return JSON.stringify({open: !document.getElementById('settings').hidden, tab: t.textContent});})()

name: share row present with the current code
move the size slider to 22: the code changes live
eval: (()=>{const before=document.getElementById('crosshair-code').value; const s=document.getElementById('pref-crosshairSize'); s.value='22'; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); const after=document.getElementById('crosshair-code').value; return JSON.stringify({before, after, changed: before!==after, size: getComputedStyle(document.getElementById('crosshair')).getPropertyValue('--ch-size').trim()});})()

name: apply the Dot preset through the input
eval: (()=>{const preset=[...document.querySelectorAll('#crosshair-share .presets button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Dot'); const code=preset.title; const i=document.getElementById('crosshair-code-input'); i.value=code.toLowerCase(); [...document.querySelectorAll('#crosshair-share button')].find(b=>b.textContent==='Apply').click(); return JSON.stringify({code, note: document.getElementById('crosshair-code-note')?.textContent, style: document.querySelector('#pref-crosshairStyle [aria-checked=true]')?.textContent, size: document.getElementById('pref-crosshairSize')?.value, current: document.getElementById('crosshair-code')?.value});})()

name: a typo is rejected with a reason
search finds the share row
eval: (()=>{const i=document.querySelector('.settings-search'); i.value='share'; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); return JSON.stringify({rows: document.querySelectorAll('.tab-body [data-tab]').length, share: !!document.querySelector('.tab-body #crosshair-share')});})()
